text:
When I close my eyes beneath the autumn sun

And breathe the aroma of your warm breast,

Happy shores take shape before me,

Dazzled by the fires of an implacable sun.


A lazy island where Nature

Produces singular trees and most savory fruits,

Men displaying agile, slender bodies,

And women with eyes where wonder is painted.


Guided by your aroma toward magical climates,

I see a harbor filled with sails and masts

Still wearied by the marine swell,


While the light perfume of the tamarind,

Circulating in the air and dilating my nostrils,

Mingles in my soul with the sailors' song.

translation.title: Exotic Perfume
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the beloved's scent as the route into tropical shore, harbor, tamarind, and sailors' song.
